posts.content_md:
I reduced my microscope objective from X40 to X10, as a result the brightness of the laser was unsuspectedly higher !

I guess this plate has been overexposed xD !!

![01D5E1F0-6A10-4637-9581-C841B124873A.jpeg](https://holographyforum.org/forum/download/file.php?id=7091)

It is literally white-opaque in the center area !
